input: Get the roof inspected before winter

gold.taskTitle: Get Roof Inspected Before Winter Arrives
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a professional roof inspection completed before winter weather sets in.

questions.title: What type of roof do you have?
questions.description: Knowing the roof material (shingles, tile, flat, metal, etc.) helps identify the right inspector and what to look for.

questions.title: Do you already have an inspector or company in mind?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan needs to include researching and vetting contractors or can skip straight to booking.

questions.title: What is your target deadline for the inspection?
questions.description: Pinning down a specific date or month ensures the plan has a concrete finish line before winter.

questions.title: Are there known problem areas you want checked?
questions.description: Existing leaks, soft spots, or damage give the inspector a focus and affect how urgent the booking is.

questions.title: What is your budget for the inspection?
questions.description: Budget affects which inspectors or services are realistic options and whether a free estimate is needed first.

questions.title: Is this for a home you own or a rental property?
questions.description: Owner vs. landlord context changes who needs to be notified, who pays, and who grants access on inspection day.

questions.title: Do you want repairs handled by the same contractor?
questions.description: Knowing whether you want an inspect-only visit or a combined inspect-and-repair service shapes which professionals to contact.
